headline: Add Jameis Winston free before Sunday 10 AM kickoff — the Giants' new season-long starter fills your open bench spot at zero cost while Caleb Williams stays hurt.
summary: Danny is 1-1 with three Questionable skill players (Aaron Jones, Jaylen Warren, Malik Nabers) all trending to play but hurt enough to need auto-sub cover. Grab Jameis Winston free for the open bench spot since Jaxson Dart's knee is season-ending and Winston is now NYG's starter, giving real QB3 insurance while Caleb Williams is Doubtful.

adds.why: Free QB3 insurance for an open bench spot while Caleb Williams is Doubtful long-term; tier is irrelevant at bid 0.
adds.evidence: Sept 23 reports confirm the Giants named Winston their starter after an MRI showed Jaxson Dart's knee will cost him the rest of the season; HC Brian Daboll's staff has expressed confidence in him. Danny's own QB3 Caleb Williams remains Doubtful (hamstring strain) on IR, and the other free-agent QB, Tyson Bagent, is himself Questionable with a concussion, so Winston is the cleaner add. Danny has 4 of 5 bench spots used, so no drop is needed.

subs.why: Jones is Questionable with a knee issue and did not practice Wednesday (Sept 23); Judkins kicks off earlier Sun 10 AM and is full cover — set the pair before then.
Nabers dislocated his shoulder Monday (Sept 21-22) and is awaiting MRI results; Johnston is the only eligible bench WR, same Sun 10 AM kickoff — set the pair before then.

watch.what: No auto-sub slot left this week (league caps 2, already used on Jones and Nabers); check Sunday's inactives around 8:30 AM PT, before his 10 AM kickoff, and be ready to swap Judkins or Lloyd in by hand if he's out.

watch.player: Jonathon Brooks (RB, CAR, dropped, on waivers)
watch.what: Panthers placed him on IR for a core-muscle injury Sept 23, out about 6 weeks — not worth a claim despite showing available.
MRI results were still pending as of Sept 23; if it shows a labrum tear his status could worsen to Doubtful/Out before Sunday — recheck Friday.

alerts.title: ➕ Add Jameis Winston free (NYG's new QB1)
